test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid to LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts c) The Head Unit shall send LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts = [Default] when IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid is missing OR until recevied during wake up.

tcs.tc_title: Default when DynamicGrid is missing (Atl-Mi), withhold the CAN signal and read the LVDS signal
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in Standby state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
4. IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP is not transmitted on the bus
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)
2. Read gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts and check that it is Default
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) is sent and the HU completes start-up
2. gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts = Default is sent over LVDS
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid to LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts c) The Head Unit shall send LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts = [Default] when IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid is missing OR until recevied during wake up.

(Default when DynamicGrid is missing (Atl-Mi), withhold the CAN signal and read the LVDS signal)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V3-284` 之 `c)` 分支（Atl-Mi 之 Default 規則），與 Atl-Hi 之 `NR1L-RVC-119`（`V2-450`）同型而本不同、逐字不同。摘句 78 → 31 token。來源之 `recevied` 為 SYS2 之拼寫（少一 `i`），依逐字原則不更正。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。
